provenance.note: An FM neuro stab: one sine throwing another at the note's own ratio, struck at twice its held index and wobbling at 7.5 Hz, the pitch falling a major third onto the note in 35 ms, driven, through a pair of formants opening from o toward a, over a 4.2 ms comb's metallic ring, with a breath of noise at 2.6 kHz in the strike. Short (a sixteenth or an eighth), a growl that answers the bass rather than doubling it.

notes.hpHz: 180 Hz: nothing of the stab under the reese's body.
notes.wobbleHz: The growl's movement: one or two turns inside a stab.
